pod_acorn.name: Acorn Capsule
pod_acorn.desc: A snug one-seat capsule. Smells faintly of toast.

pod_hearth.name: Hearth Command Module
pod_hearth.desc: Room for three and a card table.

probe_wisp.name: Wisp Probe Core
probe_wisp.desc: Flies itself, as long as the battery holds.

probe_mote.name: Mote Probe Core
probe_mote.desc: A very small brain for very small rockets.

tank_m200.name: Canister M-200
tank_m200.desc: The dependable middle child of the Canister family.

tank_m400.name: Canister M-400
tank_m400.desc: Two tonnes of propellant in a tidy tube.

tank_l1600.name: Drum L-1600
tank_l1600.desc: A big drum for big ambitions.

tank_l3200.name: Drum L-3200
tank_l3200.desc: Sixteen tonnes of propellant. Handle politely.

eng_moth.name: Moth Micro Engine
eng_moth.desc: Tiny, eager, and happiest in vacuum.

eng_sparrow.name: Sparrow Vacuum Engine
eng_sparrow.desc: Efficient upper-stage engine. Wheezes badly at sea level.

eng_goshawk.name: Goshawk Lifter Engine
eng_goshawk.desc: The workhorse first-stage engine. Steers by swivelling its bell.

eng_condor.name: Condor Heavy Engine
eng_condor.desc: Lifts practically anything. Announces it loudly.

eng_lantern.name: Lantern Thermal Engine
eng_lantern.desc: Glows gently. Extremely efficient deep-space engine.

srb_ember.name: Ember Solid Booster
srb_ember.desc: Light it and hold on. Cannot be throttled or shut down.

dec_m.name: Stack Separator M
dec_m.desc: Splits the stack in two when staged. Under an engine it carries a lattice interstage around the bell.

dec_l.name: Stack Separator L
dec_l.desc: A wide separator for wide rockets.

dec_radial.name: Radial Release Clamp
dec_radial.desc: Holds a booster to the side of the rocket, then lets go.

adapter_lm.name: Taper Adapter L-M
adapter_lm.desc: Joins large parts to medium ones.

adapter_ms.name: Taper Adapter M-S
adapter_ms.desc: Joins medium parts to small ones.

legs.name: Lander Strut
legs.desc: Folding landing leg. Toggle with G.

fin.name: Tail Fin
fin.desc: Keeps the pointy end pointed the right way.

fin_ctrl.name: Steering Vane
fin_ctrl.desc: A fin that swivels to steer in atmosphere.

heatshield_m.name: Ablative Shield M
heatshield_m.desc: Chars so the capsule does not.

heatshield_l.name: Ablative Shield L
heatshield_l.desc: A big shield for the Hearth module.

chute.name: Canopy Parachute
chute.desc: Stack-top parachute. Opens fully near the ground.

chute_radial.name: Side Parachute
chute_radial.desc: A parachute that mounts on the side.

solar.name: Sunfoil Panel
solar.desc: Unfolds to make charge from sunlight. Toggle with U.

gyro.name: Gyro Ring M
gyro.desc: Reaction wheels for extra turning authority.

rcs.name: Huff Thruster Block
rcs.desc: Small thrusters for fine control. Toggle with R.

antenna.name: Whip Antenna
antenna.desc: Lets you transmit science home (at a discount).

sci_thermo.name: Thermal Probe
sci_thermo.desc: Measures how hot or cold it is out there.

sci_baro.name: Pressure Gauge
sci_baro.desc: Measures how much air there is. Often: none.

sci_jar.name: Microbe Jar
sci_jar.desc: Pond life, observed in unusual places.

dock_m.name: Latch Ring M
dock_m.desc: Docking port. Line up two rings nose to nose, drift in gently, and they latch.

dock_s.name: Latch Ring S
dock_s.desc: A small docking port for capsule noses and probes.

pod_thimble.name: Thimble Pod
pod_thimble.desc: One Pip, knees up, elbows in. The view is excellent.

pod_burrow.name: Burrow Lander Cabin
pod_burrow.desc: A thin-walled cabin for two. Wonderful on airless moons, unwise on the way home.

pod_homestead.name: Homestead Command Deck
pod_homestead.desc: Five seats, two decks and a kettle. The flagship of the fleet.

cockpit_swift.name: Swift Cockpit
cockpit_swift.desc: A pointed single-seat cockpit with a bubble canopy and a cup holder.

cockpit_gull.name: Gull Inline Cockpit
cockpit_gull.desc: Two seats in tandem under a long canopy. Fits anywhere along the fuselage.

cockpit_albatross.name: Albatross Flight Deck
cockpit_albatross.desc: A wide-body flight deck with a wraparound windscreen. Seats four.

probe_facet.name: Facet Probe Core
probe_facet.desc: Eight gold-foiled sides, all of them the front.

probe_beacon.name: Beacon Guidance Ring L
probe_beacon.desc: A guidance ring that turns any large stack into its own pilot.

probe_keystone.name: Keystone Guidance Ring XL
probe_keystone.desc: Brains for the very biggest boosters.

rover_trundle.name: Trundle Rover Chassis
rover_trundle.desc: A flat, self-driving chassis. Add wheels, point at horizon.

tank_s100.name: Flask S-100
tank_s100.desc: Two flasks welded end to end and called a new product.

tank_s200.name: Flask S-200
tank_s200.desc: A long thin drink of propellant.

tank_l800.name: Drum L-800
tank_l800.desc: A squat drum for upper stages and landers.

tank_xl1800.name: Silo XL-1800
tank_xl1800.desc: The short one. It is still wider than the launch director's office.

tank_xl3600.name: Silo XL-3600
tank_xl3600.desc: Eighteen tonnes of propellant in one enormous silo.

tank_xl7200.name: Silo XL-7200
tank_xl7200.desc: For when the mission plan says "all of it".

fus_m.name: Sleek Fuselage M
fus_m.desc: A crash-tolerant aircraft fuselage with a fuel bladder inside.

fus_m_long.name: Sleek Fuselage M Long
fus_m_long.desc: More fuselage. More fuel. More aeroplane.

fus_m_hollow.name: Hollow Fuselage M
fus_m_hollow.desc: A structural fuselage with nothing inside but echoes.

fus_tail.name: Tail Cone M
fus_tail.desc: Tapers the back of a fuselage down to a tidy point. Holds a little fuel.

fus_l.name: Wide Fuselage L
fus_l.desc: A wide-body fuselage section for serious spaceplanes.

fus_shoulder.name: Shoulder Fuselage L-M
fus_shoulder.desc: Blends a medium nose into a wide body, with fuel in the gap.

xen_s.name: Whisper Xenon Flask S
xen_s.desc: Eighty kilograms of very expensive, very quiet gas.

xen_m.name: Whisper Xenon Drum M
xen_m.desc: Enough xenon to cross the system, eventually.

xen_radial.name: Whisper Xenon Bottle
xen_radial.desc: A side-mounted bottle of xenon for small probes.

mono_radial.name: Huff Sphere
mono_radial.desc: A little golden ball of monopropellant that bolts on anywhere.

rtank_saddle.name: Saddle Tank
rtank_saddle.desc: A slim side tank. Landers wear them in pairs.

rtank_pannier.name: Pannier Tank
rtank_pannier.desc: A fat side tank with domed ends.

eng_wren.name: Wren Booster Engine
eng_wren.desc: A small lifter that thinks it is a big one.

eng_harrier.name: Harrier Sustainer Engine
eng_harrier.desc: Burns from pad to orbit without complaint. Very wide gimbal.

eng_heron.name: Heron Spike Engine
eng_heron.desc: A spike instead of a bell: nearly as good at sea level as in vacuum. Does not steer.

eng_osprey.name: Osprey Vacuum Engine
eng_osprey.desc: A huge thin bell for large upper stages.

eng_buzzard.name: Buzzard Twin Engine
eng_buzzard.desc: Two bells on one mount. Twice the noise for nearly the same paperwork.

eng_roc.name: Roc Colossus Engine
eng_roc.desc: One bell the size of a house. Stand well back. Further.

eng_quintet.name: Quintet Cluster Engine
eng_quintet.desc: Five Goshawk-class bells sharing one thrust plate.

eng_pelican.name: Pelican Vacuum Engine XL
eng_pelican.desc: The upper-stage engine for departures to the far worlds.

eng_furnace.name: Furnace Atomic Engine
eng_furnace.desc: A reactor with a nozzle. Heavy, slow to push, and astonishingly thrifty.

eng_whisper.name: Whisper Ion Drive
eng_whisper.desc: Pushes about as hard as a sheet of paper. Never stops pushing. Needs xenon and a lot of charge.

eng_chorus.name: Chorus Ion Array
eng_chorus.desc: Four ion grids humming in harmony.

jet_midge.name: Midge Mini Jet
jet_midge.desc: A tiny turbojet for drones and impatient gliders.

jet_puffin.name: Puffin Turbofan
jet_puffin.desc: A dependable air-breathing engine. Sips fuel, hates thin air.

jet_shrike.name: Shrike Ramjet
jet_shrike.desc: An afterburning high-speed jet. Thirsty, loud, and happiest above Mach 2.

eng_gnat.name: Gnat Radial Thruster
eng_gnat.desc: A little engine that bolts to the side of things.

eng_hornet.name: Hornet Radial Engine
eng_hornet.desc: A side-mounted engine pod. Leaves the bottom of the lander free for legs.

srb_shove.name: Shove Separation Motor
srb_shove.desc: One brief, firm push to send spent boosters on their way.

srb_flint.name: Flint Kick Motor
srb_flint.desc: A small solid motor for the last shove of the trip.

srb_mallet.name: Mallet Solid Booster
srb_mallet.desc: The Maul, stretched. Subtlety was never the point.

srb_anvil.name: Anvil Solid Booster
srb_anvil.desc: A segmented solid booster as wide as a Drum tank. Pads need repaving afterwards.

dec_s.name: Stack Separator S
dec_s.desc: A dainty separator for small stacks.

dec_xl.name: Stack Separator XL
dec_xl.desc: Parts company with the biggest stages there are.

sep_s.name: Blast Ring S
sep_s.desc: A thin separator with an outsized kick.

sep_l.name: Blast Ring L
sep_l.desc: A wide ring of pyrotechnic bolts.

sep_xl.name: Blast Ring XL
sep_xl.desc: The loudest way to leave a first stage behind.

dec_radial_s.name: Radial Release Pin
dec_radial_s.desc: A small side clamp for small side things.

dec_radial_l.name: Radial Release Truss
dec_radial_l.desc: A braced stand-off for the heaviest side boosters.

adapter_xll.name: Taper Adapter XL-L
adapter_xll.desc: Joins extra-large parts to large ones.

adapter_lm_flat.name: Step Plate L-M
adapter_lm_flat.desc: A short ribbed plate for when there is no room for a taper.

coupler_bi.name: Twin Manifold
coupler_bi.desc: Splits one medium stack into a pair of engine mounts.

coupler_tri.name: Trefoil Manifold
coupler_tri.desc: Three engine mounts under one medium stack.

coupler_quad.name: Clover Manifold L
coupler_quad.desc: Four medium mounts beneath a large stack.

girder_s.name: Lattice Girder
girder_s.desc: A stout lattice beam. Structural engineers call it "honest".

girder_long.name: Lattice Girder Long
girder_long.desc: The same beam, twice as honest.

truss_m.name: Open Truss M
truss_m.desc: A round open truss section for stations and long ships.

beam_radial.name: Bracket Beam
beam_radial.desc: A stubby outrigger beam that sticks straight out.

panel_hull.name: Hull Plate
panel_hull.desc: A flat ribbed plate. Good for covering things you would rather not explain.

pylon_s.name: Stub Hardpoint
pylon_s.desc: A short fixed pylon. Hang a jet, a pod or a tank on its rail: unlike a release clamp, it never lets go.

pylon_m.name: Reach Hardpoint
pylon_m.desc: A longer pylon that holds an engine nacelle clear of the fuselage, or under a wing.

strut.name: Brace Strut
strut.desc: A cosmetic bracing strut. Makes wobbly rockets look less wobbly.

fuel_line.name: Sip Fuel Line
fuel_line.desc: A braided yellow hose with fittings. Decorative, but very convincing.

clamp_pad.name: Pad Clamp Tower
clamp_pad.desc: A launch clamp tower. Holds the rocket steady and lets go when staged.

fairing_m.name: Shroud Nose M
fairing_m.desc: A tall clamshell shroud for the top of the stack.

fairing_l.name: Shroud Nose L
fairing_l.desc: A big ogive shroud with a painted stripe.

fairing_xl.name: Shroud Nose XL
fairing_xl.desc: The cathedral roof of launch vehicles.

nose_xl.name: Aero Nose XL
nose_xl.desc: The pointiest, biggest end of all.

nose_dome_m.name: Dome Cap M
nose_dome_m.desc: A rounded cap for the tops of side boosters.

nose_slant.name: Slant Booster Cap
nose_slant.desc: A lopsided cone that steers a spent booster away from the core.

fin_swept.name: Swept Fin
fin_swept.desc: A raked-back fin for rockets that want to look fast.

fin_broad.name: Broad Fin L
fin_broad.desc: A big stabiliser for big first stages.

fin_ctrl_l.name: Steering Vane L
fin_ctrl_l.desc: A large fin with a powered trailing edge.

fin_grid.name: Lattice Vane
fin_grid.desc: A steerable grid of little blades. Shrugs off re-entry heat.

airbrake.name: Flap Air Brake
airbrake.desc: A hinged plate that swings out into the airflow. Toggle with the brakes.

intake_cone.name: Gulp Shock Cone
intake_cone.desc: A spiked supersonic air intake for the nose of an engine nacelle.

intake_ring.name: Gulp Ring Intake
intake_ring.desc: An open-mouthed intake with a fan behind it.

intake_s.name: Gulp Ring Intake S
intake_s.desc: A small round intake for small round jets.

intake_gill.name: Gill Side Intake
intake_gill.desc: A scoop that bolts to the side of the fuselage.

heatshield_s.name: Ablative Shield S
heatshield_s.desc: A saucer-sized shield for probes and Thimble pods.

heatshield_xl.name: Ablative Shield XL
heatshield_xl.desc: Enough ablator to bring a small building back from orbit.

wing_stub.name: Stub Wing
wing_stub.desc: A short square wing section. Stack them outward for more span.

wing_broad.name: Broadwing Panel
wing_broad.desc: A straight, honest main wing with visible spars.

wing_glide.name: Glide Swept Wing
wing_glide.desc: A tapered swept wing for fast, graceful aeroplanes.

wing_longspan.name: Longspan Wing
wing_longspan.desc: An enormous wing for enormous aeroplanes.

wing_strake.name: Strake
wing_strake.desc: A long sliver of wing that tidies up the airflow.

wing_tip.name: Tip Winglet
wing_tip.desc: A small swept tip. Adds a little lift and a lot of style.

canard.name: Whisker Canard
canard.desc: An all-moving foreplane. Mount near the nose for crisp pitch control.

canard_big.name: Feather Canard L
canard_big.desc: A big all-moving foreplane for heavy spaceplanes.

elevon_s.name: Flick Elevon S
elevon_s.desc: A small hinged control surface. Works out for itself whether it is pitch or roll.

elevon_l.name: Flick Elevon L
elevon_l.desc: A long heat-tolerant control surface for delta wings.

tail_rudder.name: Rudder Tail Fin
tail_rudder.desc: A proper aeroplane tail with a hinged rudder.

tail_swallow.name: Swallowtail Fin
tail_swallow.desc: A small all-purpose tail surface: mount flat for a tailplane, upright for a fin.

leg_sprig.name: Sprig Landing Leg
leg_sprig.desc: A spindly leg for probes and small landers. Toggle with G.

leg_stilt.name: Stilt Heavy Leg
leg_stilt.desc: A braced leg with a wide footpad for heavy landers. Toggle with G.

wheel_scamper.name: Scamper Rover Wheel
wheel_scamper.desc: A sprung wire-mesh wheel with its own motor.

wheel_lumber.name: Lumber Rover Wheel
wheel_lumber.desc: A chunky knobbled tyre on long-travel suspension.

gear_tuck_s.name: Tuck Nose Gear
gear_tuck_s.desc: Retractable, steerable nose gear. Toggle with G.

gear_tuck_m.name: Tuck Main Gear
gear_tuck_m.desc: Retractable twin-wheel main gear with brakes. Toggle with G.

gear_peg.name: Peg Fixed Gear
gear_peg.desc: A fixed wheel on a sprung strut with a streamlined spat.

battery_s.name: Cell Pack S
battery_s.desc: A small disc of stored charge.

battery_l.name: Cell Pack L
battery_l.desc: A large battery ring for stations and ion ships.

battery_brick.name: Cell Brick
battery_brick.desc: A stick-on battery with a charge light.

solar_tile.name: Sunfoil Tile
solar_tile.desc: A flat fixed solar tile. Nothing to unfold, nothing to snap off.

solar_slab.name: Sunfoil Slab
solar_slab.desc: A long fixed panel for rover decks and probe flanks.

solar_wing.name: Sunfoil Wing
solar_wing.desc: A long folding array on a hinged boom. Toggle with U.

solar_grand.name: Sunfoil Grand Array
solar_grand.desc: A station-class double array. Feeds ion drives comfortably. Toggle with U.

solar_fan.name: Sunfoil Fan
solar_fan.desc: A pleated circular array that opens like a paper fan. Toggle with U.

gen_glowworm.name: Glowworm Isotope Cell
gen_glowworm.desc: Warm to the touch and makes charge for decades, sun or no sun.

gen_fizz.name: Fizz Fuel Cell
gen_fizz.desc: Turns a trickle of propellant into charge. And a little water.

gyro_s.name: Gyro Ring S
gyro_s.desc: Small reaction wheels for small craft.

gyro_l.name: Gyro Ring L
gyro_l.desc: Heavy flywheels that can swing a station around.

rcs_linear.name: Huff Linear Port
rcs_linear.desc: A single thruster that pushes straight outward.

rcs_gust.name: Gust Thruster Block
rcs_gust.desc: A five-nozzle block for heavy tugs and stations.

dock_l.name: Latch Ring L
dock_l.desc: A wide docking port for station modules.

light_glim.name: Glim Spotlight
light_glim.desc: A small lamp for seeing where the ground is.

light_glare.name: Glare Floodlight
light_glare.desc: A wide twin floodlight for landing sites and rover noses.

ladder_rung.name: Rung Ladder
ladder_rung.desc: Fixed rungs. Pips insist on them.

ladder_reach.name: Reach Folding Ladder
ladder_reach.desc: A telescoping ladder that slides down to the ground.

chute_grand.name: Grand Canopy M
chute_grand.desc: A triple-canopy pack for the top of medium stacks.

chute_drogue.name: Streamer Drogue
chute_drogue.desc: A small tough chute that opens early and fast to take the edge off.

chute_drogue_radial.name: Side Drogue
chute_drogue_radial.desc: A side-mounted drogue for stabilising hot, fast descents.

antenna_saucer.name: Saucer Relay Dish
antenna_saucer.desc: A fixed dish that reaches the inner worlds.

antenna_longear.name: Longear Deep-Space Dish
antenna_longear.desc: A folding mesh dish that opens to three metres and hears whispers from the gas giant.

sci_grav.name: Plumb Gravimeter
sci_grav.desc: A very small weight on a very fine spring.

sci_seis.name: Thump Seismometer
sci_seis.desc: Listens to the ground. Works best after a firm landing.

sci_sniffer.name: Sniffer Atmosphere Analyser
sci_sniffer.desc: Takes a sip of whatever passes for air and writes down the recipe.

sci_compass.name: Compass Boom
sci_compass.desc: A magnetometer on a long boom, well away from the noisy electrics.

sci_scope.name: Peeper Survey Scope
sci_scope.desc: A gold-wrapped telescope for mapping worlds from orbit.

sci_lab.name: Tinker Lab Module
sci_lab.desc: A pressurised workshop for two. Benches, sample racks and a slightly sticky centrifuge.

pip.name: Pip (EVA)
pip.desc: A Pip in a pressure suit.
